scope: All 29 Amazon Reviews 2018 per-category rating-only CSV routes listed by the official page.
official_rights_statement: Official page says the authors do not own the data and cannot offer a license or control its use, but request research-only use. This is not an explicit permissive open-data license. The page says complete review and per-category files direct users to a form; rating-only CSV links are presented separately as directly downloadable small subsets.
task_and_architecture: All categories supply rating labels and user/item IDs; scalar rating prediction fits an MLP structurally if IDs are one-hot. Text is not needed. Dense one-hot width and full-batch tensor costs are category-specific; user cardinalities were not provided in the page table, so input tensor/optimizer estimates are incomplete.
split: No standard category train/validation/test split is documented in the source page; any benchmark split would need to be constructed or sourced separately.
probe_method: Range GET bytes=0-0 to each official rating-only CSV endpoint, no authorization headers; responses closed without saving content.

summary.hard_license_gate: No explicit permissive license; publisher only requests research use.
